content:
Hello everyone!

Is anyone currently working on a Lean4 formatter and would like to collaborate?

I noticed that there is a project that renders Lean to HTML/Markdown: https://github.com/leanprover-community/format_lean

Is the aim to extend that at some point?

It would be lovely to create something lean (unintentional pun) like go-fmt that's baked into the ecosystem.

The Lean FRO is currently working on an official code formatter that will be part of the Lean distribution, as noted in the roadmap: https://lean-lang.org/fro/roadmap/y3/#3.-language-frontend-&-developer-experience

So it probably makes sense to wait for that. More information should be available quite soon.

Hi @Julia Markus Himmel - Thank you so much!
Is there a way for me to contribute or is that an internal project?

Not right now, but once the formatter is released, it will be necessary to annotate much of the syntax that is added by Batteries and mathlib (and all other projects of course) with formatting rules. I expect that help will be very welcome there.

Awesome - I'll keep an eye on any release statements and the Github.

Looking forward.
when will the next year 4 plan will be released, the current one is only till july 2026
